subject.title: Allow up to six Overview providers

question: Should an existing installation whose Overview selection is still the legacy implicit empty value retain three providers after upgrade, or should this PR intentionally expand it to six?
rationale: Both behaviors are plausible product choices, but the current branch changes an established implicit settings outcome and the linked request does not establish that existing users should receive the larger default automatically.

options.title: Preserve legacy upgrades
options.body: Keep upgraded implicit selections at three providers with a narrow one-time migration or compatibility marker, while new installs and explicit selections may use six.

options.title: Intentionally expand all defaults
options.body: Accept that existing implicit selections become six providers and document this upgrade behavior with focused migration coverage and packaged-app proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve legacy upgrades
recommendation.body: Keep upgraded implicit selections at three providers with a narrow one-time migration or compatibility marker, while new installs and explicit selections may use six.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a product and upgrade-default decision for the repository-owned native menu experience.
